title: A non-retinol retinoic acid receptor-gamma (RAR-gamma/NR1B3) selective agonist, tectorigenin, can effectively inhibit the ultraviolet A-induced skin damage.
authors: Dai, Xintong; Jin, Jing; Jia, Yan; Yang, Kai; Han, Jingxia; Zhang, Zhiyuan; Ding, Xiujuan; Yao, Cheng; Sun, Tao; Zhu, Caibin; Liu, Huijuan
one_liner_zh: 该文筛选RAR-gamma选择性激动剂并研究其对UVA皮肤损伤的抑制作用，虽用分子对接和动态模拟，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Long-term ultraviolet (UV) exposure can cause inflammation, pigmentation and photoaging. All-trans retinoic acid (ATRA/tretinoin) is a commonly used retinoic acid receptor (RAR) agonist in the clinical treatment of UV-induced skin problems. However, the use of such drugs is often accompanied by systemic adverse reactions caused by nonspecific activation of RARs. Therefore, this study was designed to screen for a novel RAR-gamma-selective agonist with high safety. EXPERIMENTAL APPROACH: Molecular docking, dynamic simulation and Biacore were used to screen and identify novel RAR-gamma-selective agonists. RT-PCR, ELISA, western blotting, immunofluorescence staining, flow cytometry and proteomic analysis were used to detect the effects of these novel RAR-gamma selective agonists on UVA-induced inflammation and photoaging cell models. UVA-induced mouse models were used to evaluate the effects of tectorigenin on skin repair, ageing and inflammation. KEY RESULTS: Tectorigenin is a novel RAR-gamma-selective agonist, which inhibits UV-induced oxidative damage, inflammatory factor release and matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) production. Tectorigenin can also reverse the UVA-induced loss of collagen. The results of the signalling pathway research showed that tectorigenin mainly affects the MAPK/JNK/AP-1 pathway. In animal experiments, tectorigenin showed better anti-inflammatory and anti-photoaging effects, and caused less skin irritation than ATRA. Nano-particle loaded tectorigenin significantly improved the utilization of tectorigenin. CONCLUSIONS AND IMPLICATIONS: Tectorignen is a non-retinol RAR-gamma-selective agonist that can inhibit UV-induced skin damage and could be developed as a safe pharmaceutical component for the prevention of photoaging and skin inflammation.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：长期紫外线（UV）暴露可导致炎症、色素沉着和光老化。全反式维甲酸（ATRA/维A酸）是临床上常用于治疗UV引起的皮肤问题的维甲酸受体（RAR）激动剂。然而，此类药物的使用常伴随由RAR非特异性激活引起的全身性不良反应。因此，本研究旨在筛选一种具有高安全性的新型RAR-γ选择性激动剂。实验方法：采用分子对接、动力学模拟和Biacore技术筛选并鉴定新型RAR-γ选择性激动剂。通过RT-PCR、ELISA、western blotting、免疫荧光染色、流式细胞术和蛋白质组学分析检测这些新型RAR-γ选择性激动剂对UVA诱导的炎症和光老化细胞模型的影响。利用UVA诱导的小鼠模型评估鸢尾苷元（tectorigenin）对皮肤修复、老化和炎症的作用。关键结果：鸢尾苷元是一种新型RAR-γ选择性激动剂，可抑制UV诱导的氧化损伤、炎症因子释放和基质金属蛋白酶（MMP）产生。鸢尾苷元还能逆转UVA诱导的胶原蛋白丢失。信号通路研究结果表明，鸢尾苷元主要影响MAPK/JNK/AP-1通路。在动物实验中，鸢尾苷元表现出更好的抗炎和抗光老化效果，且比ATRA引起的皮肤刺激更小。纳米颗粒负载的鸢尾苷元显著提高了鸢尾苷元的利用率。结论与意义：鸢尾苷元是一种非维甲醇类RAR-γ选择性激动剂，可抑制UV诱导的皮肤损伤，并有望开发为预防光老化和皮肤炎症的安全药用成分。
